```sql
SELECT f."CDSCode", f."School Name", f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0) AS free_meal_rate
FROM frpm f
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Alameda'
  AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-15'
  AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" >= 10
ORDER BY f."School Name";
```
